preconditions.description: Both root1 and root2 must be instances of TreeNode.

postconditions.description: The function must return either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if all(sorted(level1) == sorted(level2) for level1, level2 in zip(get_levels(root1), get_levels(root2))) else return_value == 0
postconditions.description: The function must return 1 if all levels of the two trees are anagrams of each other, otherwise it must return 0.
